svg.text: MEASURED
INKLING-2-MINI TO MINIMAX-H3 IMAGE DIFFUSION · 24 DEVELOPMENT PROMPTS
A 90.0 MiB linear map stands in for a 27.14 GB text encoder and keeps
99.2% of its prompt adherence margin
The image model normally takes its prompt from a 27.14 GB encoder. Here it takes Inkling-2-Mini hidden states, passed through a ridge map
solved in closed form with no gradient steps. Each dot is one prompt; the white bar is the mean of 24.

The four-tap map was fitted on 640 prompts (13,872 aligned word spans) in
355 s on CPU. It reads four hidden-state taps from Inkling-2-Mini, so that
model has to be loaded; the teacher encoder does not.
The teacher re-injection check reproduced the native run exactly on 4 prompts
before any map was scored.
24 held-out development prompts from 16 source groups. 6-step sampling at 1024 by 1024, with the same seed and starting noise in every arm. The
sealed 160-prompt confirmation set has not been run. Margin kept is the map minus control, divided by teacher minus control.
